sentences.text: Mexico City , or the City of Mexico -LRB- Ciudad de México , -LSB- sjuˈða ðe ˈmexiko -RSB- ; abbreviated as `` CDMX '' -RRB- , is the capital and most populous city of Mexico .	Mexico	Mexico
As an `` alpha '' global city , Mexico City is one of the most important financial centers in the Americas .	Mexico	Mexico	global city	global city	Americas	Americas

It is located in the Valley of Mexico -LRB- Valle de México -RRB- , a large valley in the high plateaus at the center of Mexico , at an altitude of 2240 m .	Mexico	Mexico	Valley of Mexico	Valley of Mexico
The city consists of sixteen municipalities -LRB- previously called boroughs -RRB- .	municipalities	Boroughs of the Mexican Federal District
The 2009 estimated population for the city proper was approximately 8.84 million people , with a land area of 1485 km2 .

According to the most recent definition agreed upon by the federal and state governments , the Greater Mexico City population is 21.2 million people , making it the second-largest metropolitan area of the western hemisphere , behind New York City , the tenth-largest agglomeration , and the largest Spanish-speaking city in the world .
